hypothesis: Explicit prerequisite, grounding, subset and conditional-action instructions improve useful completion without increasing unwanted effects.
profile_scope: Exactly the same instructions for reference, native and LangGraph; no answer data or tool-specific heuristics.
diagnostic_tasks: The first 60 originally held-out tasks are now consumed for diagnosis. Candidate results on these IDs are development evidence.
fresh_confirmation_tasks: Next 10 tasks per domain after the 2 development and 10 diagnostic IDs; exact IDs recorded before inference.
stopping_rule: One guidance candidate at this version. Retain all failures. Do not revise this prompt from confirmation results.
limitations: Prompt recipe, not a new research algorithm
Initial baseline and candidate also differ by documented correctness repairs
No guarantee of SOTA or conference acceptance
